Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Tchalitchi cha Kukwapulidwa ndi Chipilala cha Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Njira ya Mtanda imayambira pa Linga la Antonia, kumene Afransiskani amasunga matchalitchi a Kukwapulidwa ndi a Chiweruzo. Akatswiri ambiri amaika Pilato m'malo mwake m'nyumba yachifumu ya Herode pafupi ndi Chipata cha Yafa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Njira ya Mtanda, Mzinda Wakale wa Yerusalemu
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Kuyambira m'Nthawi Zapakati, aulendo opembedza amapemphera Malo a Njira ya Mtanda mumsewu uwu, kuyambira pa Linga la Antonia mpaka ku Kalvare; Lachisanu lililonse Afransiskani amatsogolera mdipiti. Njira yeniyeni imene Ambuye wathu anadutsa imadalira kumene Pilato anamuweruza.
Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem: Tchalitchi Chachikulu cha Manda Oyera, Yerusalemu
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Akhristu alemekeza malo awa kuyambira mibadwo yoyamba; Woyera Helena ndi Konstantino anamanga tchalitchi chachikulu pamwamba pa thanthwe la Kalvare ndi manda opanda kanthu, ndipo lero Afransiskani ndiwo amatumikira kumeneko.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka akunena mtunda wa masitadiya makumi asanu ndi limodzi kuchokera ku Yerusalemu (Luke 24:13). Malo atatu amalemekezedwa: Emmaus Nicopolis, wosonyezedwa pano; El-Qubeibeh, wosungidwa ndi Afransiskani; ndi Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Tchalitchi cha Ukulu wa Woyera Petro, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Tchalitchi chaching'ono cha miyala yakuda m'mphepete mwa madzi, chomangidwa mozungulira thanthwe lotchedwa «Mensa Christi» (Gome la Khristu), kumene, malinga ndi mwambo, anakonzera Atumwi chakudya cham'mawa.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Tchalitchi cha Manda a Maria, chigwa cha Kidroni
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Kuyambira m'zaka za m'ma 400 zachisanu kapena kale, Mpingo wa ku Yerusalemu walemekeza manda awa m'munsi mwa Phiri la Azitona, pafupi ndi Getsemani, ngati malo amene Amayi a Mulungu anatengedwa kupita kumwamba. Nyumba ya amonke ya Kugona pa phiri la Ziyoni imakumbutsa kugona kwake; mwambo wina umanena kuti zaka zake zomaliza anakhala ndi Woyera Yohane ku Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Kachisi Waung'ono wa Kukwera Kumwamba, Phiri la Azitona
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka akuti anawatsogolera «mpaka ku Betaniya» (Luke 24:50), ndipo Machitidwe a Atumwi akuti anabwerera kuchokera ku Phiri la Azitona (Acts 1:12). Kachisi waung'ono pansonga amasunga mwala wolemekezedwa ngati umene uli ndi phazi lake lomaliza.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Mngelo Gabrieli akupereka moni kwa Namwali wodzala ndi chisomo. Pamene ayankha kuti «zichitike kwa ine monga mwa mawu anu», Mawu akusandulika munthu m'mimba mwake.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria akunyamula Ambuye wathu kupita kwa m'bale wake Elizabeti. Yohane akudumpha m'mimba ndi chimwemwe, Elizabeti akumutcha «Amayi a Ambuye wanga», ndipo Maria akuimba Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Mumzinda wa Davide, Ambuye wathu akubadwa kwa Namwali Maria, akukulungidwa m'nsalu ndi kugonekedwa m'chodyeramo ziweto, chifukwa analibe malo m'nyumba ya alendo.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Mngelo akulengeza «Mpulumutsi, amene ndi Khristu Ambuye», ndipo khamu la kumwamba likuimba kuti «Ulemerero kwa Mulungu kumwamba». Abusa akufulumira kukafuna Mwana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Anzeru ochokera kum'mawa akutsatira nyenyezi yake, akupeza Mwana pamodzi ndi Maria amayi ake, ndipo akumupatsa golide, lubani ndi mule.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria ndi Yosefe akupereka Ambuye Mwana. Simeoni akumunyamula m'manja mwake, akumutcha «kuunika kowunikira amitundu», ndipo akuuza Maria kuti lupanga lidzapyoza mtima wake.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Atachenjezedwa m'maloto, Woyera Yosefe akudzuka usiku ndi kutenga Mwana ndi amayi ake kupita ku Igupto, kutali ndi dzanja la Herode, kuti akwaniritsidwe mawu akuti: «Ndinaitana mwana wanga kuchokera ku Igupto» (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Herode atamwalira, Banja Loyera likukhazikika ku Nazarete, ndipo «mwanayo anakula, nakhala wamphamvu, wodzala ndi nzeru, ndipo chisomo cha Mulungu chinali pa iye».
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Ali ndi zaka khumi ndi ziwiri, akutsalira ku Yerusalemu pambuyo pa Paska. Pa tsiku lachitatu, Maria ndi Yosefe akumupeza pakati pa aphunzitsi: «Kodi simunadziwe kuti ndiyenera kukhala m'zinthu za Atate wanga?»
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Kwa zaka pafupifupi makumi atatu akukhala ku Nazarete, akumvera Maria ndi Yosefe, akugwira ntchito ya ukalipentala, ndipo akukula mu nzeru, msinkhu ndi chisomo pamaso pa Mulungu ndi anthu.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Yohane akumubatiza mu Yordani. Kumwamba kukutseguka, Mzimu Woyera akutsika ngati nkhunda, ndipo mawu a Atate akuti: «Uyu ndi Mwana wanga wokondedwa, amene ndikondwera naye.»
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Mzimu akumutsogolera ku chipululu, kumene akusala kudya masiku makumi anayi ndi mausiku makumi anayi, ndipo akugonjetsa mayesero a mdierekezi ndi Mawu a Mulungu.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Yohane akumusonyeza: «Taonani Mwanawankhosa wa Mulungu.» Andreya akubweretsa m'bale wake Simoni, amene Yesu akumutcha Kefa, kutanthauza Petro; Filipo ndi Natanaeli akumutsatira.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Pa mawu a Amayi ake, «Chitani chilichonse chimene akuuzani», akusandutsa madzi kukhala vinyo, chizindikiro chake choyamba, ndipo ophunzira ake akuyamba kumukhulupirira.

The Woman at the Well: Mkazi wa ku Samariya pa chitsime
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Atatopa masana, akupempha mkazi wa ku Samariya madzi akumwa, ndipo akumupatsa madzi amoyo, «kasupe wa madzi otumphukira ku moyo wosatha». Ambiri a mumzinda wake akukhulupirira.
Healing the Official's Son: Kuchiritsa mwana wa nduna ya mfumu
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Nduna ya mfumu yochokera ku Kapernao ikumupempha kuti abwere. «Pita, mwana wako ali moyo.» Pa ola lomwelo mwanayo akuchira.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: M'sunagoge akuwerenga m'buku la Yesaya, «Mzimu wa Ambuye uli pa ine», ndipo akuti: «Lero lemba ili lakwaniritsidwa.» Anthu a kwawo akumutengera m'mphepete mwa phiri, koma akudutsa pakati pawo ndi kupita.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Afransiskani amalemekeza Phiri la Kudumpha kummwera kwa mzinda ngati phiri lotchulidwa mu Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Atachoka ku Nazarete, akukhazikika ku Kapernao m'mphepete mwa nyanja, ndipo akuyamba kulalikira: «Nthawi yakwana, Ufumu wa Mulungu wayandikira. Lapani ndipo khulupirirani Uthenga Wabwino.»
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: M'mphepete mwa nyanja akuitana Simoni ndi Andreya, Yakobo ndi Yohane: «Tsatirani ine, ndipo ndidzakusandutsani asodzi a anthu.» Pambuyo pa kugwira nsomba kozizwitsa, akusiya zonse ndi kumutsatira.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Akuphunzitsa ndi ulamuliro m'sunagoge, akutulutsa mzimu woipa mwa munthu, akudzutsa mpongozi wa Petro ku malungo, ndipo dzuwa litalowa mzinda wonse ukusonkhana pakhomo.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Wofa ziwalo ndi kuitanidwa kwa Mateyu
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Abwenzi akutsitsa wofa ziwalo kudzera padenga; Yesu akumukhululukira machimo ndi kumulamula kuti ayende. Kenako akuitana Levi, Mateyu, pa malo okhometsera msonkho: «Nditsate.»
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Akuphunzitsa Madalitso, «Odala ali osauka mumzimu, chifukwa Ufumu wa Kumwamba ndi wawo», lamulo latsopano la chikondi, ndi pemphero la Atate Athu.
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Kenturiyo wa Chiroma akuti: «Ambuye, sindili woyenera kuti mulowe m'nyumba mwanga, koma nenani mawu okha.» Mpingo umabwereza mawu ake asanalandire Mgonero pa Misa iliyonse.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Akumvera chisoni mkazi wamasiye amene ankakaika m'manda mwana wake mmodzi yekha, akugwira chithatha: «Mnyamata, ndikuti kwa iwe, dzuka!» ndipo akumubwezera kwa amayi ake.
At a feast in Jerusalem He heals a man i: Pa phwando ku Yerusalemu akuchiritsa munthu amene anali wodwala zaka makumi atatu ndi zisanu ndi zitatu: «Imirira, nyamula mphasa yako, uyende.»
A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Namondwe wamphamvu akudzaza ngalawa ndi madzi, iye ali gone. Akudzudzula mphepo: «Khala chete! Bata!» ndipo kukukhala bata lalikulu. «Kodi uyu ndi ndani, kuti ngakhale mphepo ndi nyanja zimumvera?»
On the far shore He frees a man tormente: Kutsidya lina akuchiritsa munthu wozunzidwa ndi mizimu yoipa yambiri, imene ikutumizidwa m'gulu la nkhumba. Munthuyo akumupempha kuti amutsatire, koma akutumidwa kukalengeza zimene Ambuye wamuchitira.
A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Mkazi akuchira atakhudza chovala chake, ndipo akugwira dzanja la mwana wamkazi wa Yairo amene anamwalira: «Talita kumi», kutanthauza kuti: «Mtsikana, ndikuti kwa iwe, dzuka!»
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Ndi mikate isanu ndi nsomba ziwiri akudyetsa khamu, akuyang'ana kumwamba, akuyamika ndi kunyema mikate, ndipo akutolera madengu khumi ndi awiri odzaza ndi zotsala.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Pa ulonda womaliza wa usiku akubwera kwa iwo akuyenda pa nyanja. Petro akuyenda kukakumana naye, akuyamba kumira ndipo akufuula: «Ambuye, ndipulumutseni!»
In the synagogue at Capernaum He teaches: M'sunagoge wa ku Kapernao akuphunzitsa: «Ine ndine mkate wa moyo… Iye amene adya thupi langa ndi kumwa magazi anga ali nawo moyo wosatha.» Petro akuyankha: «Ambuye, tidzapita kwa yani?»
The Canaanite Woman's Faith: Chikhulupiriro cha mkazi wa ku Kanani
A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Mayi wachilendo akumupempha chifukwa cha mwana wake wamkazi: «Ngakhale agalu amadya nyenyeswa zogwa pa gome la ambuye awo.» «Mayi, chikhulupiriro chanu ndi chachikulu!»
Ephphatha, and Four Thousand Fed: Efata, ndi kudyetsa anthu zikwi zinayi
He opens the ears of a deaf man, \"Ephph: Akutsegula makutu a munthu wogontha, «Efata», kutanthauza «Tseguka!», ndipo ndi mikate isanu ndi iwiri akudyetsa zikwi zinayi amene anakhala naye masiku atatu.
Pharisees and Sadducees ask for a sign f: Afarisi ndi Asaduki akumupempha chizindikiro chochokera kumwamba. Akuwauza kuti sadzapatsidwa chizindikiro china koma chizindikiro cha Yona.
He leads a blind man out of the village: Akugwira wakhungu padzanja, akumutulutsa kunja kwa mudzi, ndipo akumusanjika manja kawiri, mpaka akuona zonse bwino.
\"Who do you say that I am?\" Peter answ: «Koma inu mukuti ine ndine yani?» Petro akuyankha: «Inu ndinu Khristu, Mwana wa Mulungu wamoyo.» «Iwe ndiwe Petro, ndipo pa thanthwe ili ndidzamanga Mpingo wanga… Ndidzakupatsa makiyi a Ufumu wa Kumwamba.»
Before Peter, James and John His face sh: Pamaso pa Petro, Yakobo ndi Yohane, nkhope yake ikuwala ngati dzuwa, Mose ndi Eliya akulankhula naye, ndipo Atate akuti: «Uyu ndi Mwana wanga wokondedwa… Mverani iye.»
He reproaches the towns where most of Hi: Akudzudzula mizinda imene anachitiramo zozizwitsa zake zambiri, Korazini, Betsaida ndi Kapernao, chifukwa sanalape.
Peter finds the Temple tax in the mouth: Petro akupeza msonkho wa Kachisi m'kamwa mwa nsomba. Kenako Yesu akuimika mwana pakati pawo: «Ngati simutembenuka ndi kukhala ngati ana aang'ono, simudzalowa mu Ufumu wa Kumwamba.»
He teaches in the Temple courts, \"Let a: M'mabwalo a Kachisi akuphunzitsa: «Ngati wina ali ndi ludzu, abwere kwa ine adzamwe», akukhululukira mkazi wogwidwa m'chigololo, «Pita, ndipo kuyambira tsopano usachimwenso», ndipo akulengeza: «Ine ndine kuunika kwa dziko lapansi.»
He smears clay on the eyes of a man blin: Akupaka dothi m'maso mwa munthu wobadwa wakhungu ndi kumutuma kukasamba m'dziwe la Siloamu. Akubwerera akuona ndipo akumupembedza: «Ambuye, ndikhulupirira.»
Martha welcomes Him while Mary sits at H: Marita akumulandira, ndipo Maria akukhala pa mapazi ake akumvetsera. «Maria wasankha gawo labwino, ndipo silidzachotsedwa kwa iye.»
Luke says only \"a village\"; John names: Luka amangonena «mudzi wina»; Yohane akutchula Betaniya ngati nyumba ya Marita ndi Maria (John 11:1).
When a disciple asks Him to teach them t: Pamene mmodzi wa ophunzira akumupempha kuti awaphunzitse kupemphera, akuwapatsa pemphero la Atate Athu.
Luke does not name the place; tradition: Luka sakunena malo; mwambo umakumbukira zimenezi m'phanga la Eleona pa Phiri la Azitona. Mateyu akupereka pemphero limeneli mu Ulaliki wa pa Phiri (Matthew 6:9-13).
Walking in the portico of Solomon in win: Akuyenda m'khonde la Solomo m'nyengo yozizira, ndipo akuti: «Nkhosa zanga zimamva mawu anga… Ine ndi Atate ndife amodzi.»
Akubwerera kumalo kumene Yohane ankabatiza poyamba. Akuphunzitsa kuti chimene Mulungu wachimanga pamodzi munthu asachilekanitse, ndipo akudalitsa ana: «Lolani ana aang'ono adze kwa ine.»
\"I am the resurrection and the life.\": «Ine ndine kuuka ndi moyo.» Yesu akulira pa manda a bwenzi lake, kenako akufuula ndi mawu akulu: «Lazaro, tuluka!» ndipo wakufayo akutuluka akadamangidwabe ndi nsalu.
As the council plots His death, He withd: Pamene Bwalo Lalikulu likukonza chiwembu choti amuphe, akubisala pamodzi ndi ophunzira ake mumzinda wapafupi ndi chipululu wotchedwa Efraimu.
Blind Bartimaeus cries, \"Jesus, son of: Wakhungu Bartimeyo akufuula: «Yesu, Mwana wa Davide, ndichitireni chifundo!» ndipo akuona. Zakeyu akukwera mtengo wa mkuyu kuti amuone: «Lero chipulumutso chafika m'nyumba muno.»
Six days before Passover, Mary anoints H: Kutatsala masiku asanu ndi limodzi kuti Paska ifike, Maria akudzoza mapazi ake ndi mafuta onunkhira a nardo amtengo wapatali, ndipo nyumba ikudzaza ndi fungo lake. Akulandira zimenezi ngati kudzozedwa kwa maliro ake.
He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Akulowa mu Yerusalemu atakwera mwana wa bulu pamene khamu likuyala zovala ndi nthambi: «Hosana kwa Mwana wa Davide! Wodala iye amene akubwera m'dzina la Ambuye!»
As He comes in sight of the city He weep: Ataona mzindawo, akuulirira: «Ukadadziwa iwenso lero zinthu zobweretsa mtendere!»
He overturns the tables, \"My house shal: Akugubuduza magome, «Nyumba yanga idzatchedwa nyumba ya pemphero kwa mitundu yonse», ndipo akuyamikira mkazi wamasiye wosauka amene anapereka makobidi ake awiri omaliza.
Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Atakhala pa Phiri la Azitona moyang'anana ndi Kachisi, akunena za kuwonongedwa kwake ndi za kubwera kwake mu ulemerero: «Chimene munachitira mmodzi wa abale anga aang'ono awa, munachitira ine.»
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Akusambitsa mapazi a ophunzira ake ndipo, atatenga mkate ndi vinyo, akuti: «Ili ndi thupi langa… Chikho ichi ndi pangano latsopano m'magazi anga… Chitani ichi pondikumbukira»; motero akupatsa Mpingo Ukaristia ndi unsembe.
He prays in anguish, His sweat like drop: M'zowawa zazikulu akupemphera, ndipo thukuta lake likukhala ngati madontho a magazi: «Atate… koma osati monga ndifuna ine, koma monga mufuna inu.» Yudasi akubwera ndi khamu ndipo akumupereka ndi kupsompsona.

Bound, He is led before Annas and the hi: Atamangidwa, akumutengera kwa Anasi ndi kwa mkulu wa ansembe Kayafa ndipo akumuweruza ngati wonyoza Mulungu. M'bwalo, Petro akumukana katatu; tambala akulira, ndipo Petro akulira kwambiri.

Carrying the cross Himself, He goes out: Atanyamula mtanda wake, akutuluka kupita ku Kalvare. Simoni wa ku Kurene akukakamizidwa kumuthandiza, ndipo akuuza akazi olira kuti: «Ana akazi a Yerusalemu, musandilirire ine, koma mudzilirire nokha ndi ana anu.»

Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap H: Yosefe wa ku Arimateya ndi Nikodemo akukulunga thupi lake m'nsalu zabafuta pamodzi ndi zonunkhira, ndipo akumuika m'manda atsopano osemedwa m'thanthwe, m'munda pafupi ndi pamene anapachikidwa.
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Pa tsiku loyamba la sabata, manda ali opanda kanthu. Ambuye wouka akuitana Maria Magdalena pa dzina lake ndipo akumutuma kwa Atumwi: «Ndaona Ambuye.»
He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Osamuzindikira, akuyenda ndi ophunzira awiri ndipo akuwafotokozera Malemba, ndipo akumuzindikira pamene akunyema mkate. «Kodi mitima yathu sinali kuyaka mwa ife?»
He stands among the apostles behind lock: Zitseko zili zotseka, akuimirira pakati pa Atumwi ndipo akuwapumira: «Landirani Mzimu Woyera. Amene mudzawakhululukira machimo, akhululukidwa», ndipo patatha sabata imodzi Tomasi akuvomereza: «Ambuye wanga ndi Mulungu wanga!»
At dawn by the lake He fills the apostle: M'mawa pa nyanja akudzaza makoka awo ndipo akuwakonzera chakudya cham'mawa. Akufunsa Petro katatu: «Kodi ukundikonda?» ndipo katatu akumupatsa udindo: «Dyetsa nkhosa zanga.»
On the mountain in Galilee He sends the: Pa phiri ku Galileya akutuma Khumi ndi Mmodzi: «Pitani tsono, phunzitsani mitundu yonse, ndi kuwabatiza m'dzina la Atate, ndi la Mwana, ndi la Mzimu Woyera… Ndipo taonani, Ine ndili pamodzi ndi inu masiku onse kufikira chimaliziro cha nthawi.»
Matthew does not name the mountain. Pilg: Mateyu sakutchula dzina la phirilo. Aulendo opembedza nthawi zambiri amakumbukira zimenezi pa Phiri la Madalitso; ena amaganiza Tabora kapena phiri la Arbel.
Forty days after Easter He blesses the a: Patatha masiku makumi anayi kuchokera pa Paska akudalitsa Atumwi, akuwalonjeza Mzimu Woyera, ndipo akutengedwa kupita kumwamba iwo akuona; akubwerera ku Yerusalemu ndi chimwemwe chachikulu.
Fifty days after Easter, as the apostles: Patatha masiku makumi asanu kuchokera pa Paska, pamene Atumwi anali m'pemphero ndi mtima umodzi pamodzi ndi Maria, Amayi a Yesu, Mzimu Woyera akutsika pa iwo m'malilime a moto. Petro akulalikira Khristu wopachikidwa ndi wouka, anthu pafupifupi zikwi zitatu akubatizidwa, ndipo Mpingo ukupita ku mitundu yonse.
At the end of her earthly life the Immac: Moyo wake wa padziko lapansi utatha, Amayi a Mulungu Obadwa Opanda Chilema, Namwali Maria wamuyaya, anatengedwa kupita ku ulemerero wa kumwamba ndi moyo ndi thupi, monga Papa Pio XII analengezera mwalamulo mu 1950. Amene anabala Ambuye ndiye woyamba kugawana nawo kuuka kwa Mwana wake.

The Rosary grew out of the prayer of the: Rozari inabadwa m'pemphero la Mpingo. Amonke ankaimba masalimo 150, ndipo Akhristu osadziwa kuwerenga ankapemphera Atate Athu 150, kenako Tikuwoneni Maria 150, akuwawerengera pa chingwe cha mikanda: «Masalimo a Maria».
By a beloved tradition, the Blessed Virg: Malinga ndi mwambo wokondedwa, Namwali Maria anapereka Rozari kwa Woyera Dominiko ku Prouille, ku Fulansa, kumayambiriro kwa zaka za m'ma 1200, kuti amuthandize mu ulaliki wake wotsutsa chiphunzitso chonyenga cha Aalbigensi. Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Woyera Papa Pio V, nayenso Mdominikani, anapatsa Rozari mawonekedwe ake okhazikika a zinsinsi khumi ndi zisanu, za Chimwemwe, za Zowawa ndi za Ulemerero, mu 1569. The land God promised to Abraham, where: Dziko limene Mulungu analonjeza Abrahamu, kumene Israyeli anakhala ngati mtundu, ndiponso kumene Yesu anabadwira, anaphunzitsa, anafa ndi kuuka. Akatolika kaŵirikaŵiri amalitcha “Uthenga Wabwino wachisanu”.

The Book of Judith is set in Bethulia, a: Buku la Yuditi likuchitikira ku Betuliya, mzinda wa ku Samariya umene malo ake sakudziŵika (Judith 4:6; Judith 6:10-11).

The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem serv: Patriyaki wa Chilatini wa ku Yerusalemu amatumikira Akatolika a ku Israyeli, Palestina, Yordani ndi Kupro, pamodzi ndi magulu a Mipingo ya Katolika ya Kum'maŵa: Amelkiti, Amaroni, Asuriya, Aameniya ndi ena.

Cyrus's decree lets the Jews go home and: Lamulo la Koresi linalola Ayuda kubwerera kwawo ndi kumanganso Kachisi ku Yerusalemu (Ezra 1:1-4; 2 Chronicles 36:22-23). Kope lake linapezeka pambuyo pake ku Ekibatana (Ezra 6:1-5).
Esther, a Jewish queen at the Persian co: Estere, mfumukazi yachiyuda m'nyumba yachifumu ya ku Perisiya ku Susa, anaika moyo wake pachiswe kuti apulumutse anthu ake; umu ndimo mmene phwando la Purimu linayambira (Esther 4:14; Esther 9:20-32). Nehemiah is cupbearer to King Artaxerxes: Nehemiya anali woperekera chikho kwa Mfumu Aritasasita ku Susa asanapite kukamanganso makoma a Yerusalemu (Nehemiah 1:1; Nehemiah 2:1-8).
Daniel sees a vision at Susa, by the riv: Danieli anaona masomphenya ku Susa, m'mbali mwa mtsinje wa Ulai (Daniel 8:2).

The Book of Judith opens with Arphaxad,: Buku la Yuditi limayamba ndi Arifakisadi, mfumu ya Amedi, amene anamanga makoma a Ekibatana (Judith 1:1-4).
Elam, in the south-west, appears from Ab: Elamu wa kumwera chakumadzulo amatchulidwa kuyambira m'nthaŵi ya Abrahamu (Genesis 14:1) mpaka kwa aneneri (Jeremiah 49:34-39).

The land between the Tigris and Euphrate: Dziko lapakati pa Tigirisi ndi Firate. Abrahamu ananyamuka ku Uri, Yona analalikira ku Nineve, ndipo Ayuda ankakhala ku ukapolo m'mphepete mwa mitsinje ya Babulo.
The Tigris and Euphrates are named among: Tigirisi ndi Firate ndi iŵiri mwa mitsinje inayi ya ku Edeni (Genesis 2:10-14).
The tower of Babel is built in 'the land: Nsanja ya Babele inamangidwa “m'dziko la Sinara” (Genesis 11:1-9).
Abram's family leaves Ur of the Chaldean: Banja la Abramu linachoka ku Uri wa Akaldeya (Genesis 11:31; Genesis 15:7).
Assyria, ruled from Nineveh, destroys th: Asuri, wolamulira kuchokera ku Nineve, anaononga ufumu wa kumpoto wa Israyeli mu 722 Kristu asanabadwe (2 Kings 17:5-6). Babulo anaononga Yerusalemu mu 587 Kristu asanabadwe (2 Kings 25:8-11).
The exiles weep 'by the rivers of Babylo: Akapolo analira “m'mphepete mwa mitsinje ya Babulo” (Psalm 137). Ezekieli anaona masomphenya m'mphepete mwa mtsinje wa Kebara (Ezekiel 1:1-3).
Tobit is a captive in Nineveh who buries: Tobiti anali kapolo ku Nineve amene ankaika maliro a akufa ngakhale kuti zinali zoopsa ku moyo wake (Tobit 1:3; Tobit 1:17-20).
Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe, reads his boo: Baruki, mlembi wa Yeremiya, anaŵerengera akapolo ku Babulo buku lake (Baruch 1:1-4).
People from Mesopotamia heard the Gospel: Anthu ochokera ku Mesopotamiya anamva Uthenga Wabwino pa Pentekoste (Acts 2:9).

Abram goes down to Egypt in a famine (Ge: Abramu anatsikira ku Igupto chifukwa cha njala (Genesis 12:10-20).

Israel is enslaved, building the store c: Israyeli anasandulika akapolo namanga mizinda yosungiramo chuma ya Pitomu ndi Ramesesi (Exodus 1:8-14). Mulungu anawapulumutsa kudzera mwa Mose ndi kuoloka Nyanja Yofiira (Exodus 12-14).
Isaiah foresees an altar to the Lord in: Yesaya analosera guwa la nsembe la Ambuye ku Igupto, Mulungu akunena kuti: “Adalitsike Igupto, anthu anga” (Isaiah 19:19-25).
Joseph, Mary and the child Jesus flee to: Yosefe, Mariya ndi Mwana Yesu anathaŵira ku Igupto kupewa Herode, kuti mawu akwaniritsidwe: “Ndinaitana Mwana wanga kuchokera ku Igupto” (Matthew 2:13-15; Hosea 11:1).
Ben Sira's grandson translated the Book: Mdzukulu wa Ben Sira anamasulira buku la Sirake m'Chigiriki atafika ku Igupto (Sirach, mawu oyamba). Chipangano Chakale m'Chigiriki, Septuaginta, chinapangidwa ku Alekizandriya ndipo chili ndi mabuku amene Akatolika amawatcha Deuterokanoniki.

Jacob wrestles with God at the ford of t: Yakobo analimbana ndi Mulungu pa doko la Yaboki, napatsidwa dzina lakuti Israyeli (Genesis 32).

John baptizes at 'Bethany across the Jor: Yohane ankabatiza “ku Betaniya kutsidya lina la Yordani” (John 1:28). Yesu anadutsa ku Dekapoli (Mark 7:31).
The Jewish historian Josephus says John: Malinga ndi wolemba mbiri Myuda Flaviyo Yosefe, Yohane M'batizi anadulidwa mutu m'linga la Herode la Makeru, kum'maŵa kwa Nyanja ya Mchere (onani Mark 6:17-29).
The baptism site at Bethany beyond the J: Malo a ubatizo ku Betaniya kutsidya lina la Yordani anayenderedwa ndi Apapa Yohane Paulo II, Benedikto XVI ndi Fransisko.
The Marian shrine of Our Lady of the Mou: Malo opatulika a Mayi Wathu wa Phiri ku Anjar amakumbutsa mwambo wakuti Yesu, Mariya ndi ophunzira anapuma kuno m'phanga.
Ancient Aram, Israel's northern neighbou: Aramu wakale, mnansi wa kumpoto wa Israyeli. Saulo wa ku Tariso anakumana ndi Kristu Woukitsidwa pa msewu wopita ku Damasiko, ndipo m'nthaŵi ya Yesu Siriya wa Aroma unafika mpaka ku Antiokeya.
Abraham's servant was Eliezer of Damascu: Wantchito wa Abrahamu anali Eliezere wa ku Damasiko (Genesis 15:2).
Naaman, an Aramean general, is healed of: Namani, mkulu wa asilikali Mwaramu, anasamba mu Yordani monga mwa mawu a Elisa, ndipo anachira khate (2 Kings 5:1-14).
Jesus' fame 'spread to all of Syria' (Ma: Mbiri ya Yesu “inafalikira ku Siriya yense” (Matthew 4:24). Kureniyo anali kazembe wa Siriya pamene Yesu anabadwa (Luke 2:2).
Saul is blinded by the light of Christ o: Pa msewu wopita ku Damasiko, Saulo anachititsidwa khungu ndi kuunika kwa Kristu, ndipo anabatizidwa mumzinda (Acts 9:1-19).
Villages such as Maaloula still speak a: M'midzi monga Maalula anthu akulankhulabe Chiaramu, chilankhulo chimene Yesu ankalankhula.
The Melkite Greek Catholic Patriarch has: Patriyaki wa Mpingo wa Katolika wa Amelkiti Achigiriki ali ku Damasiko. Siriya ilinso ndi Akatolika Asuriya, Amaroni, Aameniya ndi a Chilatini.
St John Paul II prayed at the shrine of: Woyera Yohane Paulo II anapemphera mu 2001 pa manda a Woyera Yohane M'batizi mu Mzikiti wa Aumayyadi ku Damasiko; ndiye Papa woyamba kuloŵa mu mzikiti.
The coast of the Phoenicians, whose ceda: Gombe la Afoinike, limene mitengo yake ya mkungudza inagwiritsidwa ntchito mu Kachisi wa Solomo. Yesu anapita kumadera a Turo ndi Sidoni, ndipo Eliya anakhala ndi mkazi wamasiye ku Zarefati.
King Hiram of Tyre sends cedars of Leban: Hiramu, mfumu ya Turo, anatumiza mitengo ya mkungudza ya ku Lebanoni kuti amange Kachisi wa Solomo (1 Kings 5).
Elijah is fed by the widow of Zarephath: Eliya anadyetsedwa ndi mkazi wamasiye wa ku Zarefati, ndipo anaukitsa mwana wake (1 Kings 17:8-24; Luke 4:25-26).
The Psalms and the Song of Songs praise: Masalimo ndi Nyimbo ya Nyimbo amatamanda mitengo ya mkungudza ndi fungo labwino la Lebanoni (Psalm 104:16; Song of Songs 4:8-15).
Jesus heals the daughter of a Syrophoeni: Yesu anachiritsa mwana wamkazi wa mkazi Msurofoinike m'madera a Turo (Mark 7:24-30).
Lebanon is home of the Maronite Catholic: Lebanoni ndi kwawo kwa Mpingo wa Katolika wa Amaroni, umene Patriyaki wake ali ku Bkerke, komanso kwa Akatolika Amelkiti, Asuriya ndi Aameniya.
The Kadisha Valley, the 'Holy Valley' be: Chigwa cha Qadisha, “Chigwa Choyera” pansi pa Mitengo ya Mkungudza ya Mulungu, chinali pothaŵira pa anthu odzipatula ndi kwawo kwa amonke Amaroni kwa zaka mazana ambiri.
Lebanese saints include St Charbel Makhl: Pakati pa oyera a ku Lebanoni pali Woyera Sharbel Makhlouf, Woyera Rafqa ndi Woyera Nimatullah al-Hardini.
More New Testament places lie in Turkey: Turkey ili ndi malo ambiri a Chipangano Chatsopano kuposa dziko lina lililonse kupatula Dziko Loyera: Tariso kumene Paulo anabadwira, Antiokeya, Efeso, Mipingo ya Galatiya ndi Mipingo isanu ndi iŵiri ya Chivumbulutso.

Abraham lives at Haran before setting ou: Abrahamu anakhala ku Harana asanapite ku Kanani (Genesis 11:31 - 12:5).
Paul is born at Tarsus in Cilicia (Acts: Paulo anabadwira ku Tariso wa ku Kilikiya (Acts 22:3). Ku Antiokeya ophunzira anayamba kutchedwa Akhristu (Acts 11:26).
Paul's journeys take him through Pisidia: Maulendo a Paulo anamufikitsa ku Antiokeya wa ku Pisidiya, Ikoniyo, Lusitra ndi Derbe (Acts 13-14), ndipo analembera Agalatiya (Galatians 1:2).
1 Peter is addressed to Christians in Po: Kalata yoyamba ya Petro inalembedwera Akhristu a ku Ponto, Galatiya, Kapadokiya, Asiya ndi Bituniya (1 Peter 1:1).
Revelation is written to seven churches: Chivumbulutso chinalembedwera Mipingo isanu ndi iŵiri ya ku Asiya: Efeso, Smurna, Pergamo, Tiyatira, Sarde, Filadelfiya ndi Laodikaya (Revelation 1:11).
The first ecumenical councils, at Nicaea: Masinodi akuluakulu oyambirira a Mpingo anali ku Nikaya (325), Konstantinopole (381), Efeso (431) ndi Kalikedoni (451), mu Turkey wa lero.

St John XXIII served in Istanbul as the: Woyera Yohane XXIII anatumikira ngati nthumwi ya Papa ku Istanbul kuyambira 1935 mpaka 1944. Magulu ang'onoang'ono a Akatolika a Chilatini, Aameniya, Akaldeya ndi Asuriya alipobe.
Paul first brought the Gospel to Europe: Pano Paulo anayamba kubweretsa Uthenga Wabwino ku Ulaya, ku Filipi, kenako ku Tesalonika, Atene ndi Korinto. Chipangano Chatsopano chenichenicho chinalembedwa m'Chigiriki.
Daniel's vision of the goat stands for ': M'masomphenya a Danieli, tonde ndi “mfumu ya Grisi”, Alekizanda Wamkulu (Daniel 8:21). Buku loyamba la Amakabeo limayamba ndi zigonjetso za Alekizanda (1 Maccabees 1:1-9).
Jonathan Maccabeus writes to the Spartan: Yonatani Makabeo analembera Aspata kuti akonzenso ubwenzi (1 Maccabees 12:1-23).

Paul founds churches at Philippi, Thessa: Paulo anayambitsa Mipingo ku Filipi, Tesalonika, Bereya ndi Korinto, ndipo analalikira ku Atene (Acts 16-18).
John receives the Book of Revelation on: Yohane analandira Chivumbulutso pa chilumba cha Patmo (Revelation 1:9).
Sts Cyril and Methodius, apostles to the: Oyera Sirilo ndi Metodiyo, atumwi a Asilavo ndi oteteza Ulaya, anabadwira ku Tesalonika.
St John Paul II visited the Areopagus in: Woyera Yohane Paulo II anayendera mu 2001 Areopagi ku Atene, kumene Paulo analalikira.
Greece has small Latin and Greek Byzanti: Grisi ili ndi magulu ang'onoang'ono a Akatolika a Chilatini ndi a mwambo wa Chigiriki-Bizanti. Tchalitchi Chachikulu cha Katolika ku Atene chaperekedwa kwa Woyera Dionisiyo wa ku Areopagi, amene Paulo anamutembenuza (Acts 17:34).
Rome, capital of the empire, received Pa: Roma, likulu la ufumu, linalandira Paulo ngati mkaidi; malinga ndi mwambo wakale, Petro ndi Paulo anaferako ngati ofera chikhulupiriro. Papa, woloŵa m'malo mwa Petro, akukhalabe kuno.
Judas Maccabeus makes a treaty of friend: Yuda Makabeo anachita pangano laubwenzi ndi Aroma (1 Maccabees 8:17-32).
Visitors from Rome are in Jerusalem at P: Pa Pentekoste panali alendo ochokera ku Roma mu Yerusalemu (Acts 2:10).
Paul writes his Letter to the Romans bef: Paulo analembera Aroma asanafike (Romans 1:7-15), kenako, ali mkaidi, anafika ku Regiyo ndi Puteoli popita ku Roma (Acts 28:13-16).
Hebrews sends greetings from 'those from: Kalata kwa Ahebri imatumiza moni kuchokera kwa “a ku Italiya” (Hebrews 13:24).

St Peter's Basilica stands over Peter's: Tchalitchi cha Woyera Petro chaimirira pamwamba pa manda a Petro, ndipo Tchalitchi cha Woyera Paulo Kunja kwa Makoma pamwamba pa manda a Paulo.
Vatican City, inside Rome, is the seat o: Dziko la Mzinda wa Vatikano, lomwe lili mkati mwa Roma, ndi kwawo kwa Papa.

Paul leaves Titus in Crete to appoint el: Paulo akusiya Tito ku Krete kuti asankhe akulu mu mzinda uliwonse (Titus 1:5).
Capital of the empire, where Paul preach: Likulu la ufumu, kumene Paulo analalikira ali mkaidi ndi kumene, malinga ndi mwambo, Petro ndi Paulo anapereka miyoyo yawo. Manda a Petro ali pansi pa Tchalitchi cha Woyera Petro.
Judas Maccabeus sends envoys to Rome to: Yuda Makabeo akutumiza nthumwi ku Roma kukachita pangano (1 Maccabees 8:17-20).
Paul writes to 'all the beloved of God i: Paulo akulembera “onse okondedwa a Mulungu a ku Roma”, amene chikhulupiriro chawo “chikulalikidwa padziko lonse” (Romans 1:7-8).
Paul arrives as a prisoner and for two y: Paulo akufika ali mkaidi, ndipo kwa zaka ziŵiri akulandira onse obwera kwa iye, “akulalikira ufumu wa Mulungu” (Acts 28:16-31).
Peter sends greetings from the church 'i: Petro akutumiza moni kuchokera ku Mpingo “wa ku Babulo”, umene ambiri amamvetsa kuti ndi Roma (1 Peter 5:13). Yesu akulosera mmene Petro adzafere (John 21:18-19).
Peter was crucified on the Vatican Hill: Petro anapachikidwa pa Phiri la Vatikano m'nthaŵi ya Nero, cha m'ma chaka cha 64-67 Kristu atabadwa, ndipo Tchalitchi cha Woyera Petro chaimirira pamwamba pa manda ake. Zofukula pansi pa guwa lalikulu zinalengezedwa ndi Piyo XII mu 1950.
Paulo anadulidwa mutu pa msewu wopita ku Ostia. Tchalitchi cha Woyera Paulo Kunja kwa Makoma chimasunga manda ake.
The Church celebrates both apostles toge: Mpingo umakondwerera atumwi onse aŵiri pamodzi pa 29 Juni.
The busy port near Naples where Paul lan: Doko lotanganidwa pafupi ndi Napoli kumene Paulo anafika ku Italiya napeza Akhristu ali kale kumeneko.
At Puteoli 'we found some brothers and w: Ku Puteoli “tinapeza abale, ndipo anatipempha kuti tikhale nawo masiku asanu ndi aŵiri. Ndipo potero tinafika ku Roma” (Acts 28:13-14).
Christians from Rome come out to meet hi: Akhristu a ku Roma akutuluka kukakumana naye ku Msika wa Apiyo ndi ku Nyumba Zitatu za Alendo (Acts 28:15).
Where tradition says Paul's ship ran agr: Kumene mwambo umati ngalawa ya Paulo inaima pa mchenga ku Malta.

A viper fastens on Paul's hand as he gat: Mphiri ikugwira dzanja la Paulo pamene akutola nkhuni, ndipo akuikutumulira kumoto osavulazidwa (Acts 28:3-6).
Paul heals the father of Publius, the is: Paulo akuchiritsa atate a Publiyo, mkulu wa chilumbacho (Acts 28:7-10).
A statue of St Paul stands on St Paul's: Chiboliboli cha Woyera Paulo chaimirira pa Zilumba za Woyera Paulo m'gombe. Malta imakondwerera pa 10 Febuluwale Phwando la Kusweka kwa Ngalawa ya Woyera Paulo.
The Roman capital of Cyprus, where the p: Likulu la Aroma ku Kupro, kumene kazembe Sergiyo Paulo anakhulupirira.
Paul and Barnabas preach in the synagogu: Paulo ndi Barnaba akulalikira m'masunagoge a ku Salami (Acts 13:5).
At Paphos the magician Elymas is struck: Ku Pafo wamatsenga Elima akuchititsidwa khungu, ndipo kazembe Sergiyo Paulo akukhulupirira (Acts 13:6-12). Kuyambira pano Luka akutcha Saulo kuti “Paulo”.
St Paul's Pillar at the church of Agia K: Mzati wa Woyera Paulo pa tchalitchi cha Agia Kyriaki Chrysopolitissa umasonyezedwa ngati malo amene Paulo anakwapulidwa. Tchalitchichi chimagwiritsidwa ntchito ndi Akatolika ndi Aangilikani.
Greek city of Libya, home of Simon who c: Mzinda wachigiriki wa ku Libiya, kwawo kwa Simoni amene ananyamula mtanda wa Yesu, ndi wa Yasoni, amene mbiri yake inakhala buku lachiŵiri la Amakabeo.
Simon, a Cyrenian, 'the father of Alexan: Simoni, wa ku Kurene, “atate wa Alekizanda ndi Rufo”, akukakamizidwa kunyamula mtanda (Mark 15:21).
2 Maccabees condenses the five books of: Buku lachiŵiri la Amakabeo likufupikitsa mabuku asanu a Yasoni wa ku Kurene (2 Maccabees 2:19-32).
Men of Cyrene first preach the Lord Jesu: Anthu a ku Kurene ndiwo oyamba kulalikira Agiriki ku Antiokeya za Ambuye Yesu (Acts 11:20).
Royal city of Nubia, whose queens bore t: Mzinda wachifumu wa Nubiya, umene mafumukazi ake ankatchedwa Kandake, monga mfumukazi imene nduna yobatizidwa ndi Filipo inkaitumikira.
Tirhakah, king of Cush, marches against: Tirihaka, mfumu ya Kusi, akunyamuka kukamenyana ndi Senakeribu (2 Kings 19:9).
'Look, there is water. What is to preven: “Taona, madzi awa. Nchiyani chikundiletsa kubatizidwa?” Nduna ya Kandake ikubatizidwa nkupitiriza ulendo wake ikukondwera (Acts 8:26-39).
The Ethiopian official is honoured as on: Nduna ya ku Etiopiya imalemekezedwa ngati mmodzi mwa akunja oyamba kubatizidwa, Korneliyo asanabatizidwe.
